type.description: Authority type: gnd-persons, gnd-places, gnd-subjects, gnd-corporate-bodies, gnd-works, wikidata, geonames, aat, or null for no binding

pattern.description: Regex pattern. Null means no regex rule.

vocabulary.description: Closed vocabulary list. Null means no vocab rule.

fuzzy_distance.description: Levenshtein distance for opt-in fuzzy vocab match. Null = exact.

corrector_enabled.description: Per-field opt-in for LLM corrector when rule fails.

name.description: Both the identifier and the display label, exactly as scalar field labels work today. No separate label abstraction.

description.description: Instruction passed to the VLM for this child. Null means none.
Instruction passed to the VLM for the group as a whole. Null means none.

fields.description: The group's child fields, in template order. That order fixes the canonical serialisation and the CSV column order.

max_items.description: Freezes the CSV width for this group; it does not cap extraction. Entries beyond it are preserved in the group's overflow column and counted, never dropped. 12 for groups created in the UI; the AMIGA Titel_Tracks group uses 20.

field_groups.title: Field Groups
field_groups.description: Map of group_label -> FieldGroup. The label itself stays an ordinary entry in `fields`. Null means a scalar-only template, which behaves exactly as before this side-map existed.

prompt_template.title: Prompt Template
prompt_template.description: Custom VLM prompt template with {{fields}} placeholder. Null means use default.

field_rules.title: Field Rules
